text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: In 1st place is Hishi Akebono--!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, gaaasp*~! Jeez, seriously...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: This is the best~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bono, listen... I... I'm just... I'm so 
incredibly frustrated right now!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I gave it everything I had!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bono's big back was right in front of me, 
and I wanted to overtake her so badly... 
That's why, that's why—!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Bono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah...! Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That was amazing! So freakin' intense!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Buono is huge, fast, and so powerful! The 
turf kicking up behind her has insane 
force!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Like when they passed right in front of 
me, realizing someone so amazing is right 
there, it's like... time? Time just 
stopped! Haha!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Biko-chan, you were amazing too! From the 
moment you entered the gate, I could feel 
your soul crying out to win――"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Her aura was so huge, to me she looked as 
big as Buono-chan!

Thunderous applause envelops the Umamusume 
who put on such a magnificent race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the inspiring race!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I-It's the Carrotman audience seats...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ......Biko-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know, right now! Deep in my chest, it 
feels super hot and all tight and squeezy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Like a piping-hot, freshly made chanko 
nabe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I got to run with Biko-chan 
today~! Right now, today is the hottest, 
most fiery day ever~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Biko-chan!!

Overcome with emotion, Hishi Akebono 
wrapped Biko Pegasus in a massive embrace.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Me too, Bono! Thanks for running with 
me!"

The applause and excitement at Chukyo 
Racecourse did not subside for quite a 
while.
Meanwhile, back at Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Akebono and Biko! What a 
hot and exciting race!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"‘Have you already decided on your next 
target race?’"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, I guess it's the Yasuda Kinen after 
all~. I wanna give it my all and crash 
right into it head-on~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Trainer, would that be okay with 
you~?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I see, the "Yasuda Kinen"...! The battle 
to crown the mile king, where all the 
fighters gather!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case! We cannot afford to 
waste any time!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Next, I'll go right by your side!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's Taiki-san. ...Wait, she's so 
fast! She's gotten ridiculously fast over 
this past year, hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Right? I wonder if she's running in the 
next Yasuda Kinen?

Hishi Akebono, who left a powerful impact 
on countless spectators and Umamusume 
alike at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

With the Yasuda Kinen set as our next 
goal, days of dedicated training began!
